### 🐄 Livestock Census, Dairy Breeds & Physiological Benchmarks

1. **20th Livestock Census Benchmarks:**
   • Total Livestock population in India = **535.78 Million** (Cattle: 192.5M, Buffaloes: 109.8M, Goats: 148.9M, Sheep: 74.3M).
   • India ranks **#1 globally in Milk Production** ((247	ext{ Million Tonnes in 2025})) and **#1 in Buffalo population**.
2. **Indigenous Cattle Breed Classifications:**
   • **Milch Breeds (High Milk Yield):** Gir (Gujarat/Saurashtra), Sahiwal (Punjab/Haryana, highest milk yield ~2,500L/lactation), Red Sindhi, Deoni.
   • **Draught Breeds (Work/Ploughing):** Amritmahal, Hallikar, Kangayam, Khillari, Nagori.
   • **Dual-Purpose Breeds:** Haryana, Tharparkar, Ongole, Kankrej (famous for "Sawai Chal" gait).
3. **Physiological & Gestation Invariants:**
   • **Cattle (Cow) Gestation:** **280 to 285 days** ((sim 9	ext{ months } 9	ext{ days})); Estrous cycle = (21	ext{ days}).
   • **Buffalo Gestation:** **310 days** ((sim 10	ext{ months } 10	ext{ days})).
   • **Sheep & Goat Gestation:** **148 to 152 days** ((sim 5	ext{ months})).
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Animal Gestation Periods in NABARD Grade A: Cow (282 days) vs Buffalo (310 days) vs Goat (150 days). Sahiwal has the highest milk fat yield among Indian indigenous cow breeds.
